tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dza ya ba ti nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gi thos pa dus cig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab/ bya rgod phung pa'i ri la dge slong stong du tshang ba'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ mi'i rgyal po rnams la sman pa dang*/ bde ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can zhes bgyi ba 'di bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje khyod kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrag 'bum phrag du mas gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang snying brtse ba'i phyir nga yang da ltar 'chad pa 'di zung zhig /tad+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ya ba ti ya/ bhud ya adhiṣ+ṭhi te dharma a ba bha sa ni bud+dha a dhi ka me/ dz+nyā na a ba bha se swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams te/ lag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i tshig 'di dag gang gi lus la btags sam/ glegs bam la bris pa de'i lus dpag tshad stong tshun chad du phyir rgol ba'i gnod pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// mtshon dang*/

dug dang*/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs so// rgyal po de'i yul der pha rol gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ngo*// phyir rgol ba dag yul 'khor der mthus gnod par mi 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di yi ger bris te 'chang ba de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du de'i lus la mtshon dang*/ dug dang*/ chu dang*/ rims dang*/ dug sbyar ma gzhan gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// de la dgra'i 'jigs pa dang*/ 'tshe ba dang mtho mtshams pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa mi 'byung*/ 'thab mo'i nang du song yang de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi phog /thams cad du yang nga rgyal ba smra bar 'gyur/ gnod pa med cing ma bsnad ma rmas par rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di'i mthu dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ stobs dang*/ byin gyis brlabs kyis rgyal bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ dza ye dza yod ta mi/ dharma a ba bha sa ni/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya/ dha ra dha ra dha ra/ bo dha ni bo dha ni bo dha ni/ ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ a ba ro ha ni/ o ro bya ni/ dza ya kus ma sā re sa ra ba ti/ dri ḍhe dri ḍhe dri ḍhe/ dri dhe pa sha ra bi dhe/ oṃ ha ni ma ha na/ dzam+bha ni/ staṃ bha ni/ staṃ bhi ta/ sarba a hi te ṣi ṇa na/ na mo bha ga wa ti/ bud+dha s+ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇaṃ sid dh+yan+tu man+t+ra ba di swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ dza ya dza ya dza ya/ pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ badz+ra pra ha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra dha ra/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/

bha ra bha ra bha ra bha ra/ dza ya ku su me/ ba la ba la/ tsakra tsakra/ pī ḍa ya pī ḍa ya/ a kra ma/ a kra ma/ bi kra me/ a tsa le/ ma tsa le/ kha ga tsa ri nī/ ni la ba ti/ badz+ra pra ha ra ṇi/ badz+ra saṃ bha bha be/ badz+ra ka ya/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhī te/ bud+dha rash+mi ma hā pra bhe/ ud tsa gan+dhe/ ma hā te dza ba ti/ ma tsa le/ ba tsa le/ dhu na dhu na dhu na/ ka ka kang re/ kā si ni/ sa mā hi te/ dharma u ba bha sa ni/ tsa ra tsa ra/ gha gha ḍa/ badz+ra mā lā dha ri/ sa ra sa ra/ ka la ba ḍa ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus gsungs pa ste/ su zhig rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di las 'da' bar bgyid pa de dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la 'khus par 'gyur ro// 'di lta ste/ lha 'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ yi dwags sam/ sha za 'am/ brjed byed dam/ gsod byed dam/ byad dam/ ro langs sam/ bkra mi shis pa'am/ ma mo'i gdon tam/ gong ma'i gdon tam/ skem byed dam/ skem byed kyi gdon tam/ za ba'i gdon de dag thams cad rmugs par bgyi'o// rengs par bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ badz+ra badz+re ha na badz+re/ ni ha na badz+re/ khā da khā da/ badz+ra ṇi/ spa ṭa ya spa ṭa ya spa ṭa ya badz+ra ṇi/ hū ma hū ma hū ma/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gra sa gra sa gra sa/ pā ta ya/ pā ta ya/ dha ra dha ra/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ 'thab mo dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'gyed pa thams cad las srungs shig /dza ya ka rī/ dza yaṃ ku ru/ ta ra ta ra ta ra/ ma hā ta ra naṃ ku ṭe ku ṭe ku ṭe/ badz+ra ku ṭe swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje la legs so zhes bya ba byin no// lag na rdo rje legs so legs so// lag na rdo rje sems can chen po khyod sems can rnams la phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ snying brtse ba'i phyir zhus pa yang legs so// lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di su'i lag tu song ste/

lus la btags sam/ glegs bam du bris sam/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ra ma/ grong rdal laṃ/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ gnas khang ngam/ 'chags na spyod par 'gyur ba der rgyal po chen po rnams thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas pas grong ngam/ grong khyer ram grong rdal lam/ yul der bsrung bar 'gyur ro// yul der pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis gnod par mi 'gyur ro// sa phyogs mi ngas mi 'byung ngo*// dgra mi 'byung ngo*// rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag phyi bzhin 'brang ba dang lan gcig der bsrung ngo*// yongs su skyob bo// yongs su 'dzin to// zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur pa byed do// chad pa spong ngo*// mtshon cha spong ngo*// dug gsod do// mi mdza' ba 'gog go /mtshams gcod do// sa bcing ngo*// tad+ya thā/ ta pa ni ta pa ni/ pra ta pa ni/ dhu ru me dhu ru me/ bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhī te/ mu khe su mu khe/ su mu khe/ sba la pra te/ sa mā hi te/ sa ma dhi gar+bhe/ ma na si/ phu ru phu ru phu ru/ dhu ru bud+dha/ mā na si ka swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'o// gsang ba'i gnas so// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o// lag na rdo rje mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di glegs bam la legs par bris te/ 'chang ngam/ lus la btags te 'chang zhing de la spos dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub kyis bsti stang du byed/ bla mar byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed/ mi'i rgyal po de la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin phyi bzhin 'brang ba bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu bsrung bar 'gyur ro// mi'i rgyal po de la phyir rgol ba dang*/

dgra dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad kyis glags mi rnyed do// mthus yul der 'jug pa dang*/ gegs 'jug na yang*/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gegs sna tshogs brgya dang*/ gegs sna tshogs stong byed par mi 'gyur ro// mi'i rgyal po gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te mdun du bskur bar bya'o// gang du g.yul ngor 'jug gam/ dgra chen po dang 'thab pa der rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di mgul du btags te/ g.yul ngor zhugs na der rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus pha rol gyi dmag tshogs de pham par byed par 'gyur ro// der ni rgyal bar byed par 'gyur ro// rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di su'i mgul du btags pa de rgyal bar 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rje grong ngam grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor gang du gal te nad 'go ba sna tshogs byung na/ cho ga dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bum pa btung ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ba bzhi phyogs bzhir bzhag ste/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di klog na de'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas shing*/ gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu nad 'go ba dang*/ mi ngas de rab tu zhi bar byed par 'gyur ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das 'di las lhag pa'i rig sngags ches stobs dang ldan pa'am/ gzi brjid che ba'am/ rdzu 'phrul che ba'am/ mthu che ba gang yang ma mchis so// rig sngags thams cad kyi mchog /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di yul gang dag tu spyod par 'gyur ba'i gnas de dag tu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/

badz+re badz+re badz+re/ a mri ta badz+ra/ dz+wa li ta badz+re/ hu tā sha ne/ bhan dza bhan dza bhan dza/ bhan dza bhan dza/ staṃ bha ya/ sarba sa gra ha naṃ/ hum hum hum/ pāṭa pāṭa pāṭa/ gh+ra sa gh+ra sa gh+ra sa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa/ bha ṭā/ mu ru mu ru mu ru/ dha ma dha ma dha ma/ dza la dza la dza la/ khu khu me/ khu khu me/ ghi ri ghi ri ghi ri/ badz+ra ma nā si/ badz+ra hu ti/ hu ti ru/ phu ru phu ru/ gra sa gra sa/ sarba a hi te/ ṣa nan/ nā bhu ru ṇa/ mu mu le/ badz+ra pra dhi ba ni/ tsa ma le phu swā hā/ a yu bā la ni tsu tsu re swā hā/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ dza ya saṃ bha bhe swā hā/ dza yod ta me swā hā/ dza ya ba ra de swā hā/ dza ya le dha ne swā hā/ dza ya mā na si swā hā/ dza ya bi dza swā hā/ dza ya ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ badz+ra hu ta sha nā ya swā hā/ a mo gha badz+ra hastā ya swā hā/ de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bsrung ba stsal bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ chad pa spang ba dang*/ mtshon cha spang ba dang*/ dug 'gum pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba dgag pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'gum pa dgag pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'thab mo dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'gyed pa dang*/ g.yul 'gyed pa dang*/ khrag 'khrug dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad dgag par bgyi'o// mtshams 'gum par bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ye/ mī lī mā na si/ dzhe dzhe dzhe/ mu ru mu/ tu ṭu tu ṭu/ mu mu le/ mārga ba ti/ dhu dhu me/ be ga be ga dha ri ṇaṃ/ ti dza ba ti/ bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las srungs shag srungs shig swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag ni/

sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgus gsungs pa byin gyis brlabs pa lags so// tad+ya thā/ bud+dhe bud+dhe bud+dhe/ bud+dha ba ti/ bud+dha a ba bha sa ni/ dha ma ba ti/ sa mā hī te/ sa mā dhi gar+bhe/ bud+dha a ba bha sa ni/ bud+dha pa ri hi raṃ/ dha ra a ba bha sa ni swā hā/ su la la zhig rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di las 'da' bar bgyid pa de'i mgo sid dha ka'i 'bras bu bzhin du tshal pa bdun du 'gas so// su zhig rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod par bgyid dam/ yi ger 'bri'am/ glegs bam la bris te grong ngam/ grong khyer ra ma/ grong brdal la ma/ ljongs sam/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor ram/ gtsug lag khang du 'jog na der bdag tshogs kyi g.yog dang bcas shing*/ gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu rig sngags 'dzin pa de'i slad bzhin du 'brangs te bsrung bar bgyi'o// dpag tshad brgyad stong tshun tshad mtshams dgum par bgyi'o// slar rgol ba dang*/ dgra dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ mtshang 'bru ba dang*/ 'thab mo dang*/ 'gyed pa thams cad ma mchis par bgyi'o// slar bzlog par bgyi'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rgyal po chen po legs so legs so sems can chen po khyod 'jig rten thams cad la phan pa dang*/ 'jig rten thams cad la bde ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba dang*/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir zhus pa yang legs so// rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di gang yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyab pa byas pa de'i lus la mtshon dang*/ dug dang*/ byad dang*/ gsod byed dang*/ rims dang*/ gdon thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgyas btab pa'o// lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can 'di zung zhig

/chongs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /lag na rdo rje phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la dam pa'i chos rab tu rnam par 'jig pa'i dus na/ sems can drag shul can dang ldan pa/ shin tu mi bzad pa mdangs 'phrog pa'i gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po rnams dang*/ chos ma yin pa spyod pa'i rgyal po 'byung bar 'gyur ro// tshe thung ba chos ma yin pas yul 'khor skyong ba 'byung ba de'i tshe/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di sems can mi mnyam pa dang*/ sems can mi bzad pa de dag dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don du 'gyur/ tshar gcod par 'gyur/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo rgyal ba can bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du mas gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ phyag rgyas btab bo/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di ni lha thams cad kyis phyag byas pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje de'i phyir khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang phyag rgya zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa rgyal ba can zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang*/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang*/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa rgyal ba can zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
